notes: Deposit 1-80 gold in the stone bowl to receive one of eight blessings, lasting 3-7 days (the granting day counts as day 1). Only one blessing can be active at a time; taking the offering back curses the player for 2 days instead, per resources-lost-per-drafted-colour (engine/effects/rooms/shrine.py). Live in engine/effects/rooms/shrine.py plus dispatch sites in engine/game.py (draft-time hooks, redraw's dice bonus, rotation's Dancer source, reset()'s Gardener injection). Records carrying 'implemented': true are live; the rest (Chef, Monk) are inert and carry meta.blocked_on.

Coin costs below are the LOWER value of each published two-coin pair (e.g. Dancer/3-day is published as 1 or 2 coins; this data stores 1) -- the wiki itself notes 'there is little reason to offer an even number of coins... other than to deliberately deprive oneself of gold', so the odd/low value reproduces the identical blessing/duration outcome for the minimum spend. The action space (env/actions.py) exposes 8 blessings x 5 durations = 40 donate actions rather than 80 raw coin amounts, deriving the coin cost from this table.

The wiki records one irregularity: within the 3-day band only, the published Chef/Tinkerer costs (7-8 and 11-12) are swapped relative to the otherwise-consistent +16-per-band pattern every other blessing follows across all five bands. Both blessings' 3-day costs are stored here exactly as published (Chef=7, Tinkerer=11), not 'corrected' to the pattern.

blessings.name: Blessing of the Dancer
blessings.text: While drafting, you may pay 1 gem to spin floorplans.

blessings.name: Blessing of the High Roller
blessings.text: Each time you draft a Shop, gain 1 die. Gain 5 extra coins each time you roll dice.

blessings.name: Blessing of the Gardener
blessings.text: Add 8 Courtyards to your draft pool

blessings.name: Blessing of the Tinkerer
blessings.text: Whenever you draft a Mechanical Room, trigger your current experiment.

blessings.name: Blessing of the General
blessings.text: After you draft a Red Room, if you have at least 5 different ranks containing Red Rooms, gain 5 gems.

blessings.name: Blessing of the Chef
blessings.text: For each different type of spread addition that you do each day, add an extra dish to the Dining Room.

blessings.name: Blessing of the Monk
blessings.text: If you call it a day in a room in your house, you will have the opportunity to draft that room from the grounds the following day.

blessings.name: Blessing of the Berry Picker
blessings.text: While drafting, instead of picking a floorplan, you can pick a berry. If you do, draft a floorplan at random from your draft pool disregarding rarity.

curse.source: taking back a previously-offered donation; loses the active blessing immediately
notes: Applied once per drafted room, additively across every colour category the room carries (Room.is_category) -- reproduces both published examples: the Maid's Chamber (primary red + extra bedroom) loses 2 steps/1 key/1 gem/1 coin, and the Aquarium (every colour) loses 2 of each.

veranda is exempt per the wiki's published bullet ('The Veranda does not incur any penalty'). NOT modelled: the wiki's own commented-out (unpublished) claim that the Veranda's exemption does not hold when its cost is bypassed. NOT modelled: the Corriyard is only treated as a Hallway not a Green Room, and colour-changing Cloister upgrades still count as Green Room -- both are published (non-commented) refinements this table does not encode.
